finding: A byte-identical GET error response has no currently proven M-to-host winner channel under isolated native serialization. Requiring both byte-identical headers and new exported evidence would be an unsatisfiable design constraint.
decision: For design only, permit one explicitly identified lab-only diagnostic error-egress header on the exact finite-prepare GET failed response, analogous to the already admitted POST error marker. Preserve original status/body, actual work/retention, clocks/guards/order and all non-diagnostic output. No new IO/await/poll/read/clock. Default OFF outside synthetic fixture. Require value-provenance limitations and separate focused actual positive transport controls before considering any future business run. M-only winner contract is preferred when QA phase cannot be joined faithfully.
costIfWrong: Discard detached design or require smaller channel; no source implementation or native/runtime change released.
